text: NovaFit communications must never promise guaranteed results or specific outcome timelines. Physical fitness adaptations differ by metabolic and lifestyle factors. Absolute claims like guaranteed weight loss or 100% foolproof are strictly prohibited.

Use encouraging, realistic, and inclusive language. Avoid hyperbolic generalizations like works for everyone or effortless fitness. Emphasize accessible movements and meeting users at their current level.
Mandatory disclaimer requirement: Results vary by individual. Must accompany any customer transformation testimonial or short-term program claim mentioning days, weeks, or timelines.
The primary brand slogan is Progress Over Perfection. Discontinued slogans such as No Pain No Gain, Crush the Weak, and Beast Mode 24/7 are deprecated and prohibited across all channels.
The brand name must always be written in PascalCase as NovaFit (single word). Spellings like Nova Fit, Nova-Fit, or lowercase novafit violate trademark guidelines.
